title: Paper Trading and Live Portfolio Monitoring Now Available in ChatGPT with Alpaca
summary: Explore agentic trading with Alpaca's new Paper and Live plugins in ChatGPT. Monitor balances, analyze trends, and place simulated trades using natural language.
body_markdown:
A question you ask AI about a stock becomes more useful when you put it in the context of your own account: the cash available, the positions you already hold, and the orders still waiting to fill. Without that context, you are moving between a conversation and a dashboard to assemble the answer.


Our new plugins in ChatGPT aim to address this problem, combining natural language with your account context. The[Alpaca Paper Trading plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd5e06dbd8?ref=alpaca.markets) connects to your paper[Trading API](https://alpaca.markets/algotrading?ref=alpaca.markets) account and[Market Data API](https://alpaca.markets/data?ref=alpaca.markets) , enabling you to analyze market trends, monitor your account, and place simulated trades across stocks, ETFs, options, and crypto using natural language. The[Alpaca Live plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186aa2e413e1?ref=alpaca.markets) connects to your live Trading API and Market Data API account for portfolio monitoring, market research, and account management.

## **Using the Alpaca Paper Trading Plugin**


### **Start with an account check**


Start a ChatGPT conversation with “Alpaca Paper Trading” to surface the plugin, then complete the Alpaca sign-in and authorization flow when prompted. To follow along with the prompts below,[create an Alpaca paper account](https://app.alpaca.markets/signup?ref=alpaca.markets) and connect to the[Alpaca Paper Trading plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd5e06dbd8?ref=alpaca.markets) .


An example of what your first prompt can look like:


` Alpaca Paper Trading: Show my Alpaca paper account balance, buying power, and account status.`


Illustrative paper-trading example. Values shown are simulated and are not indicative of actual account results.


Compare the response with the paper account in your Alpaca dashboard. Buying power tells you what the account can use for orders under its current limits.


If the account or balances do not match, resolve the connection before proceeding. If you have multiple paper accounts, confirm which account you’ve connected. If the mismatch persists, contact Alpaca Support rather than using an order to test the connection.


### **Submit a paper order, then check its status**


Once you have verified the account, try submitting a simulated order. Just replace the “ABC” placeholder text with the symbol you wish to use for this simulated demonstration.


` Alpaca Paper Trading: In my Alpaca paper account, submit a day market order to buy 1 share of ABC. Show the order ID and current status returned by Alpaca.`


Read the response before taking another action. An order acknowledgment does not establish that the order has been filled.


Then ask:


` Retrieve the current status of that paper order. Show the filled quantity and average fill price if available, then refresh my paper positions and buying power.`


Illustrative paper-trading example. Values and positions shown are simulated and are not indicative of actual results.


The distinction matters when an order remains open, fills partially, or is rejected. Inspect the returned status and any rejection message instead of assuming that a conversational confirmation means the position changed.


## **Using the Alpaca Live Plugin**


Find the[Alpaca Live plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186aa2e413e1?ref=alpaca.markets) in the plugin directory, or start a ChatGPT conversation with “Alpaca Live” to surface the plugin and complete the Alpaca sign-in and authorization flow for your live account.* Learn more about[how to open a live account as a non-US resident](https://alpaca.markets/learn/live-trading-account-non-us?ref=alpaca.markets) or[as a US resident](https://alpaca.markets/learn/live-trading-account-us-resident?ref=alpaca.markets) .


Start by checking your balances and positions:


` Alpaca Live: Summarize my live Alpaca account balances, buying power, and open positions. Include the retrieval time and identify any information you could not retrieve.`


A follow-up can narrow the view:


` Alpaca Live: Show my open orders and recent fills. Keep pending orders separate from completed trades.`


**Illustrative account display. Symbols shown are not recommendations. Confirm that the final publication uses synthetic data or an authorized demonstration account.**


Note: The Alpaca Live plugin does not place orders. You must use[Alpaca's Trading API](https://alpaca.markets/algotrading?ref=alpaca.markets) or Dashboard for live execution.


## **Know what the connection can return**


Account access, market data access, and order execution are separate checks. A successful balance request does not establish that every symbol, data feed, or asset class is available.


If a Market Data request fails, inspect the returned message and your data entitlements (such as checking whether your account uses free basic data or a paid Algo Plus Trader subscription) before changing the prompt. For options or crypto requests, confirm both account eligibility and support in the plugin's published listing. Reconnecting alone may not resolve a missing permission or unsupported tool.


Paper trading has its own limits.[Alpaca's paper trading documentation](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/paper-trading?ref=alpaca.markets) lists factors the simulation does not model, including market impact, price slippage due to latency, order queue position, and regulatory fees. A completed paper order demonstrates the simulated workflow. It does not predict a live fill.


## **Try your first paper order**


Get started with the[Alpaca Paper Trading plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd5e06dbd8?ref=alpaca.markets) , verifying connection with an account check. Once complete, submit one simulated order, and follow its status through to the result. That gives you an account record to inspect alongside the conversation.


If your goal is live portfolio visibility, use the[Alpaca Live plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186aa2e413e1?ref=alpaca.markets) . If you need to build and control a programmatic workflow, explore[Alpaca's Trading API documentation](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/paper-trading?ref=alpaca.markets) and developer resources below.
